releases.summary: Behavioral safeguards and recoverable offline dictation.

changes.title: Recover undelivered speech in Clipboard
changes.detail: Recognized blue-mic dictation that could not safely reach its original field is held in a separate, encrypted five-item Clipboard rail with timestamps and manual insertion.

changes.title: Safer editor transitions
changes.detail: Restarting editors now recheck action keys and no-learning flags; delayed voice results cannot auto-insert into a changed field or selection.

changes.title: Trackpad selection and correction undo
changes.detail: Added second-finger horizontal trackpad selection with pointer ownership and Unicode stepping; autocorrection reversal checks the editor text before changing it.

releases.summary: Emoji navigation remembered within a typing session, reset across new sessions.

changes.title: Emoji session navigation
changes.detail: Browsing a category and returning to ABC remembers the position within the editor session. Focusing a new session starts at Recents or Smart instead of an old category.

changes.title: Emoji geometry diagnostics
changes.detail: Added non-content diagnostic checks for the reported Emoji top-gap. The remaining panel gap requires direct on-device verification.
